\documentclass{article}
\usepackage[paperwidth=300pt,paperheight=260pt,textwidth=260pt,textheight=220pt,left=20pt,top=20pt]{geometry}
\usepackage{dirtreex}
\pagestyle{empty}
\parskip=0pt
\parindent=0pt

\makeatletter
\newcount\AuditSkips
\let\AuditSkip\dte@skipcolumn
\def\dte@skipcolumn{%
  \global\advance\AuditSkips by1
  \typeout{AUDIT-SKIP \the\AuditSkips; page=\thepage; total=\the\pagetotal; goal=\the\pagegoal; vsize=\the\vsize; avail=\the\dte@availht; scratch=\the\dte@fitroom; min=\dte@minht; temp=\the\dte@tempdim}%

  \AuditSkip}
\let\AuditOutput\dte@output@breakable
\def\dte@output@breakable{\typeout{AUDIT-FIRST page=\thepage; total=\the\pagetotal; goal=\the\pagegoal}\AuditOutput}
\let\AuditCont\dte@dosplit@cont
\def\dte@dosplit@cont{\typeout{AUDIT-CONT page=\thepage}\AuditCont}
\ifcsname dte@check@progress\endcsname
\let\AuditCheck\dte@check@progress
\def\dte@check@progress#1#2{\AuditCheck{#1}{#2}\typeout{AUDIT-CHECK #1; deficit=\the\dte@tempdim; room=\meaning\dte@retryroom; stop=\if@tempswa yes\else no\fi}}
\fi
\makeatother



\makeatletter
\ifcsname dte@check@defer\endcsname
  \let\DGcheck\dte@check@defer
  \def\dte@check@defer{%
    \typeout{DG-DEFER attempt=\the\numexpr\dte@defercount+1\relax;piece=\the\dte@pagecount;tree=\the\dte@tnum}%
    \DGcheck}
\fi
\makeatother
